rule: Every view the user has flagged is rendered from its cameras for the candidate and the live release, next to the photograph where a panorama exists, before any publish (check_flagged_views.py writes <candidate>/flagged-views/; publish_full_candidate_v24.py refuses a candidate without it). The sheets are looked at at native resolution. A defect listed here is reported as fixed only when its sheet shows it gone from these cameras; a new defect seen on a sheet is added here. Coordinates are scene metres (x east, y north, z up; ground here is about 2.3 m). This file is review data for checking releases; the generator never reads it. Each flagged camera with a panorama also compares the flagged building's wall colour with the photograph (check_flagged_views.py, dE with lightness at half weight > 18 blocks publishing, --known-mismatch only for a registered open defect the release does not touch and no worse than live).

defects.text: The block's set-back faces are scalloped zig-zag brick walls.
defects.cause: Tier outlines are polygonised from a north-up 1.5 m roof raster; on a footprint at 45 degrees they keep the cell staircase (about 300 vertices per tier).

defects.text: One vertical block is drawn as three stacked boxes (4-10.8, 10.8-19, 19-22.3 m) with a cornice and white ledge at each join.

defects.text: The set-back top storey is missing; the model stops at about 22-23 m.

defects.text: The podium walls carry dark garage-like openings and shopfront glazing; the photographs show a blank planter wall.
defects.cause: The hand reading of the planter wall carries the 21.4 m frame height, so the low-blank-wall continuity rule (reading height 6 m or less) never applies to the podium's other walls.

defects.text: Corners are square; the building's corners are rounded.
defects.cause: Outlines keep polygon corners; nothing measures a corner radius.

defects.text: Brick texture where the building is clad in small square tiles.
